recommended: Have clients retry the rejected orders.

Re-run check_invariants once the error-rate window has cleared.

root_causes: Deploy v1.5 (new order request validation) rejected orders with 'unknown field currency_code', so /orders returned 500s.
evidence: recent_changes: v1.5 deployed 16:17:21, just before the errors began
api ERROR x37: order validation failed: unknown field 'currency_code'
Error rate was 50-63% at first. The last error was logged at 16:17:29, after which the rate fell 54% -> 44% -> 36% -> 31%.
args.impact: About 37 /orders requests failed with 500 and those orders were rejected, so the clients must retry them. No orders were lost after acceptance: 14 orders created, 14 paid, 0 unpaid, 0 ledger failures, 0 dropped.
recommended_actions: Have clients retry the rejected orders.
Fix v1.5 so it accepts currency_code before redeploying.
Re-run check_invariants once the error-rate window has cleared.
args.summary: v1.5 broke order validation by rejecting the currency_code field, so /orders returned 500s. I rolled back to v1.3, and no new errors have been logged since. check_invariants still reports a high error rate (31%), because the rolling window still holds the old failures. That rate is falling, and I expect it to clear on its own.
